118572.name: Chabad of Mid Suffolk
118572.note: The Commack shul (1800 Jericho Turnpike): Rabbi Tuvia Teldon (COLlive, 14 July 2023): 'After six years in Stony Brook, we moved to Commack, in Suffolk County, and opened a shul' (they began in 1977, so about 1983). Its own page (posted 2004): 'Since joining Chabad of Commack in August of 2004, Rabbi Mendel and Brocha Teldon' ... 'Building on 25 years of Chabad success'. Medium: the year is counted from 'six years'.

118234.name: Chabad of Wall Street
118234.note: JTA (11 Sept 2008): 'The Chabad of Wall Street, which was established two years before the 2001 attack' (so 1999). Medium: counted from that. Rabbi Shmaya and Rachel Katz, 139 Fulton Street.

119792.name: Chabad of the Hamptons
119792.note: The Algemeiner (31 Aug 2012): 'Chabad of East Hampton celebrated eight years as a resource for Jewish life in the Hamptons' (so 2004). Medium: a count back. Before it, Rabbi Leibel Baumgarten (Lubavitch of the East End) held Shabbat services in Jewish homes around the Hamptons (The Jewish Week, on COLlive).

118575.name: Chabad of Briarcliff-Ossining
118575.note: The Jewish Link (30 Nov 2023): 'Before 2002, the neighboring towns of Briarcliff Manor and Ossining in Westchester County had no Chabad presence'; 'Chabad of Briarcliff Manor & Ossining ... recently celebrated its 20th anniversary' (so 2003). The Jewish Link (5 Aug 2021): the Labkowskis came 'more than 16 years ago'. GuideStar gives an IRS ruling year of 2003. Medium: a count back.
